items.title: Amounts to follow
items.text: Shares proposed by Marketing, not modelled

notes: The budget split. We show categories and proposed shares only. Amounts will be submitted separately. Drink stations and kit take 30%, the largest share. Co-branded packs and store activity take 25%. Stub deals and ticket prizes 15%. Content and online 15%. Attribution and data 8% and contingency 7%: together 15%, ring-fenced and not to be moved. Without attribution we cannot say what the money did. Without contingency, a typhoon or a postponement means asking for more mid-season. The money is released in two tranches, the second only after the first stop passes review.
